# Layout and structure

Positioning inside a container is the CSS layout engine's job (`layout` /
`layoutItem` — see [CSSLayout.md](../../UltraCanvas/../CSSLayout.md)), not manual arithmetic on
`SetBounds`.

| Element | What it is for | Callbacks |
|---|---|---|
